=== registers by name
	.set noreorder
	.text
f:
	.cfi_startproc
	addiu $sp, $sp, -32
	.cfi_def_cfa_offset 32
	sw $ra, 28($sp)
	sw $fp, 24($sp)
	.cfi_offset $ra, -4
	.cfi_offset $fp, -8
	move $fp, $sp
	.cfi_def_cfa_register $30
	.cfi_offset $s0, -12
	.cfi_offset $16, -16
	.cfi_offset $s8, -20
	.cfi_register $31, $at
	.cfi_same_value $zero
	.cfi_undefined $gp
	.cfi_undefined $k0
	move $sp, $fp
	lw $ra, 28($sp)
	lw $fp, 24($sp)
	addiu $sp, $sp, 32
	.cfi_def_cfa $sp, 0
	.cfi_restore $31
	jr $ra
	nop
	.cfi_endproc
=== a frame in .debug_frame with lines
	.set noreorder
	.cfi_sections .debug_frame
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.text
f:
	.loc 1 3 0
	.cfi_startproc
	addiu $sp, $sp, -8
	.cfi_def_cfa_offset 8
	.loc 1 4 5 prologue_end
	move $2, $0
	.loc 1 5 1
	jr $ra
	addiu $sp, $sp, 8
	.cfi_endproc
